rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose everyday choice for something exaggerated, sensational, or melodramatic.

example.english: The report was so lurid that it made an ordinary quarrel sound like a bloodbath.
example.traditional: 嗰篇報道寫得好誇張，將一場普通爭執講到好似血案咁。
example.jyutping: go2 pin1 bou3 dou6 se2 dak1 hou2 kwaa1 zoeng1 zoeng1 jat1 coeng4 pou2 tung1 zang1 zap1 gong2 dou3 hou2 ci5 hyut3 on3 gam3

rows.note: Pick this when the presentation deliberately tries to stir emotions or sensationalize shocking or sexual material.

example.english: The drama uses a lurid style to portray a tragic love affair.
example.traditional: 套劇以煽情手法描寫一段悲戀。
example.jyutping: tou3 kek6 ji5 sin3 cing4 sau2 faat3 miu4 se2 jat1 dyun6 bei1 lyun2

rows.note: Use this especially for shocking, sensational news or accounts that attract attention because they are horrifying.

example.english: The newspaper used lurid headlines to attract readers.
example.traditional: 報章用聳人聽聞嘅標題吸引讀者。
